clusters.use: a transient panel over the page — filters, a picker, a short form

instead.when: the viewport is md or wider
the user has to answer before anything continues

clusters.use: switching between panels of one screen, where each panel is substantial

instead.when: the choice is between two or three short options and changes a view in place
it is the app's primary navigation, anchored to the bottom
it is the app's primary navigation, standing in a column beside the page

clusters.use: a label on content the reader cannot press — a category, a topic

instead.when: pressing it filters or selects something
it reports state or a count rather than naming content

clusters.use: a page's centred column, with the page-edge padding it owns

instead.when: the content is one raised, self-contained thing
it is the whole screen, with a bar above or below it

clusters.use: vertical flow, with the gap owned by the parent

instead.when: the children sit in a row
the children are rows of one settings-style list
the text runs to more than one line
it is a password and wants a reveal toggle
it is a search box that should clear itself
the answer is one of a known set

clusters.use: body copy, labels and metadata — anything that is not a section title

instead.when: it starts a section and belongs in the document outline

clusters.use: content on its way, in a shape the reader will recognise when it lands

instead.when: the wait is short and has no shape to stand in for
there is a measurable amount of work left

clusters.use: an independent yes/no that a form submits

instead.when: the change takes effect the moment it is tapped
it is one of several answers to one question
the few options are worth showing side by side

clusters.use: a glyph that carries meaning next to, or instead of, a word

instead.when: it stands for a person
it stands for several people at once

clusters.use: something happens when it is pressed

instead.when: it goes somewhere, and sits inside a sentence
it toggles a count the reader contributes to — a like, a reaction

clusters.use: several chips inside a form, wrapping onto new lines so none is hidden

instead.when: it is a filter strip that should stay on one scrolling line

clusters.use: the list came back and there was nothing in it

instead.when: it has not come back yet

clusters.use: telling the reader something landed, without taking the screen away

instead.when: they have to answer before anything continues

clusters.use: a place to hand over a file — pressed for the picker, or dropped on

instead.when: the file is already on its way and what is left to show is how far it has got

clusters.use: a titled row of items that runs off the edge of the screen — featured posts, a shelf of covers

instead.when: the items are pictures the reader looks at one at a time
everything should be in view at once rather than scrolled past
the row is filters rather than content
